**Xvnc** is a virtual X11 display server with built-in VNC, useful for headless desktops and remote display sessions.

This package includes the iOS compatibility patch needed for clean startup and drops the unavailable `tigervnc-xorg-extension` dependency.

- Gives you an X11 desktop you can reach from any VNC client at `127.0.0.1`
- Installs the standalone server alongside the shared TigerVNC tools
- Works well with a window manager (`fluxbox`), `xterm`, and fonts

## 1.11.0+rootless1  ·  2026-06-29
- Rebuilt from source for rootless /var/jb
- Fix: X server spawns its xkbcomp helper via /var/jb/bin/sh (was /bin/sh), so keyboard init no longer crashes
- Drop the unsatisfiable tigervnc-xorg-extension dependency so it installs with dpkg/apt
